name: scienceevolve
description: A Codex-powered autonomous multi-agent research and paper-writing system.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.r-projects:validate: npm run build -w server && node scripts/r-projects/validate.mjs
scripts.r-projects:launch: npm run build -w server && node scripts/r-projects/launch.mjs
